Dream big, yes. Live in a dream world, no.

Kevin Trudeau says people on stage who tell you that you can have anything you want are setting people up for disappointment. They send you after things you have no real chance of reaching.

His answer: think big and fantasize, then come back and ask what your next logical step is. Pick a target you know you can hit, focus on it, and go one step at a time.

What is your next logical step right now?
